auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

business.createHint: A business is your workspace. You can add more later.
business.name: Business name

expertise.title: How would you describe yourself?
expertise.hint: This sets how simple or detailed CHIMERA looks. You can change it any time in settings.
expertise.business_owner_desc: I run a business. Keep it simple and guide me.
expertise.technician_desc: I carry out innovation work: ideas, projects, tasks.
expertise.specialist_desc: I design and tune innovation programs and criteria.
expertise.manager_desc: I own the innovation system. Show me everything.

home.soon: Your dashboard will appear here as we build the next sections.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Everything that makes up your innovation system: the people, resources, concepts and activities, and how they relate.

emptyHint.person: Add the people who take part in innovation: your team, customers, partners, experts.
emptyHint.resource: Add what you use: budgets, tools, spaces, data, incentives.
emptyHint.concept: Add ideas, knowledge, frameworks and the culture you work in.
emptyHint.activity: Add what gets done: processes, projects, programs, training.

detail.needTwo: Add at least two items to link them together.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.hint: Propose ideas, evaluate them with clear criteria, and decide which ones to build.
ideas.emptyHint: Be the first: describe a problem or an opportunity in a few lines.
ideas.formHint: Keep it short. You can always add detail later.
ideas.anonymousOn: Nobody will know who sent this idea, not even the administrators. You also will not be able to edit it later.
ideas.anonymousOff: Your name will be shown with the idea.
ideas.criteriaHint: Choose the criteria for this idea and how much each one counts (1 to 5).
ideas.criteriaHintSimple: We suggest the standard criteria. Tap one to turn it on or off.
ideas.buildHint: This idea is approved. Turn it into a project to start working on it.

gateCriteria.problem_clear: The problem and the goal are clearly described
gateCriteria.team_assigned: A team and a responsible person are assigned
gateCriteria.prototype_ready: A working prototype or first version exists
gateCriteria.validated_users: It has been tested with real users or customers
gateCriteria.launch_ready: Everything needed to launch is in place

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: Approved ideas become projects. Each project moves forward only when it passes a gate.
projects.emptyHint: Approve an idea and turn it into a project, or start a project from scratch.
projects.formHint: Start with a name. You will define the details at the first gate.
projects.shippedHint: This project is complete. The result now lives in your Inventory.
projects.gateHint: All criteria must be met before the project can move on.
projects.newCriterion: Add a criterion for this gate
projects.unmet: {{count}} criteria still to meet before you can move on.
projects.is_stopped: This project was stopped. You can resume it.

iso56002.name: ISO 56002 innovation management system
iso56002.description: The international standard for managing innovation: understand your context, set a strategy, plan, support, run the innovation process, measure and improve.

context.title: Understand the organization and its context
context.description: Study customers, market, competitors and internal strengths that shape innovation.

strategy.title: Set the innovation vision and strategy
strategy.description: Decide where innovation should take the business and how.

planning.title: Plan innovation objectives and initiatives
planning.description: Turn the strategy into objectives, budgets and a plan of initiatives.

opportunities.title: Identify opportunities
opportunities.description: Collect needs, problems and ideas from inside and outside the business.

concepts.title: Create and validate concepts
concepts.description: Shape promising ideas into concepts and check that they make sense.

solutions.title: Develop and deploy solutions
solutions.description: Build the validated concepts and bring them to the market or into operations.

evaluation.title: Evaluate innovation performance
evaluation.description: Measure results against objectives and review them with management.

improvement.title: Improve the system
improvement.description: Act on what the evaluation shows to make the innovation system better.

stage_gate.name: Stage-Gate
stage_gate.description: A staged path from discovery to launch, with a decision gate between each stage. Good for structured product development.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Look for opportunities and collect raw ideas.

scoping.title: Scoping
scoping.description: Make a quick, low-cost assessment of the most promising ideas.

business_case.title: Build the business case
business_case.description: Define the product, the market, the cost and the expected return.

development.title: Development
development.description: Design and build the product or service.

testing.title: Testing and validation
testing.description: Test the solution with real users and in real conditions.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Bring the product or service to market.

gate_reviews.title: Gate reviews
gate_reviews.description: Decide at each gate whether to go on, hold or stop.

design_thinking.name: Design Thinking
design_thinking.description: A human-centred way to solve problems: understand people, define the real problem, imagine, prototype and test.

empathize.title: Empathize
empathize.description: Observe and listen to the people you are designing for.

define.title: Define the problem
define.description: State clearly the problem worth solving.

ideate.title: Ideate
ideate.description: Generate many ideas, then choose the best ones.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.description: Build quick, simple versions to make ideas tangible.

test.title: Test
test.description: Try the prototypes with users and learn from their reactions.

lean_startup.name: Lean Startup
lean_startup.description: Learn fast with little money: test your riskiest assumptions with a simple product and decide from real data.

assumptions.title: Identify the riskiest assumptions
assumptions.description: List what must be true for the idea to work.

build.title: Build a minimum viable product
build.description: Make the smallest version that can test the assumptions.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Collect real data on how customers behave.

learn.title: Learn and decide
learn.description: Decide whether to pivot, persevere or stop.

programs.title: Programs
programs.hint: A program is how innovation gets done: activities performed by people, using resources, to produce ideas and results.
programs.emptyHint: Start from a proven methodology or build your own from scratch.
programs.newHint: Pick a methodology to start from. Everything can be changed afterwards.
programs.scratchHint: An empty program: you add the activities, people and resources yourself.
programs.name: Program name
programs.noActivities: No activities yet. Add the first one below.
programs.removeHint: Tap an item to remove it from this activity.
programs.searchExisting: Search or type a new name
programs.deleteHint: The program is removed. Its activities and people stay in your Inventory.

ideas_submitted.name: Ideas submitted
ideas_submitted.hint: Counts the ideas people have proposed.

ideas_approved.name: Ideas approved
ideas_approved.hint: Counts the ideas that were approved.

projects_shipped.name: Projects shipped
projects_shipped.hint: Counts the projects that passed the last gate and were shipped.

projects_active.name: Active projects
projects_active.hint: How many projects are running right now.

inventory_count.name: Items in the Inventory
inventory_count.hint: Counts items in the Inventory, for example people, tools or concepts.

idea_score_avg.name: Average idea score
idea_score_avg.hint: The average weighted score of all evaluated ideas, from 1 to 5.

manual.name: Entered by hand
manual.hint: You type the value yourself, for example hours of training done.

goals.title: Goals and KPIs
goals.hint: Set what you want to achieve and watch it move. Each goal is measured by a KPI that CHIMERA calculates from your data.
goals.emptyHint: Start with something simple, like collecting 20 ideas this quarter.
goals.emptyKpisHint: KPIs are created with your goals, or on their own here.
goals.formHint: A goal is a target on something you can measure.
goals.kpiFormHint: A KPI is a measure you want to keep an eye on.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.hint: Know your innovation field, state the assumptions behind your choices, and keep a versioned strategy.
strategy.driftBody: {{changed}} of the {{total}} assumptions behind this strategy have changed since it was written.
strategy.dueBody: Check them to see if they still hold.
strategy.fieldHint: Your innovation field is everything that can bring or inspire innovation in your business: people, resources, concepts and activities, including culture. “Monitored” means someone keeps an eye on it.
strategy.fieldEstimate: How many do you think exist? (optional)
strategy.fieldEmpty: Nothing in the Inventory yet. Add items there first.
strategy.assumptionsHint: An assumption is a reason behind a choice to use, or not use, something. Writing it down lets you check it later.
strategy.noAssumptionsHint: Start with the biggest choice you made, for example why you do not use a certain tool.
strategy.strategiesHint: A strategy describes what you use, what you do not use and why. Each version is kept, so you can see how your choices changed.
strategy.noStrategiesHint: Create the first one to describe how things are today (AS IS).
strategy.summaryPlaceholder: In a few lines: what does this strategy aim for, and what are its main choices?
strategy.investmentsHint: Put how much you invest in each activity. Zero means the activity is not used.
strategy.noActivities: No activities yet. Add them in Programs or the Inventory.
strategy.noAssumptionsYet: Add an assumption first to explain why.
strategy.activateHint: The current strategy is archived and a transition is recorded.

assumption.formHint: We will help you write it so it can be checked later.
assumption.statementPlaceholder: e.g. We do not use an idea platform because our team is too small to need one
assumption.trigger: What change would make this false?
assumption.triggerPlaceholder: e.g. The team grows beyond 15 people
assumption.triggerHint: A good assumption says what would invalidate it. This is what tells you when to review the strategy.
assumption.reviewHint: Does this still hold? Record what you found.
assumption.acceptRisk: Keep the strategy as it is, accepting the risk if invalid

notif.title: Notifications
notif.hint: What needs your attention across the business.

gate_due.label: Gate decision
gate_due.title: “{{title}}” is ready for review
gate_due.body: All exit criteria are met. Decide whether to pass the gate.

goal_at_risk.label: Goal at risk
goal_at_risk.title: “{{title}}” is behind
goal_at_risk.body: Progress is behind where it should be for the deadline.

strategy_review.label: Strategy
strategy_review.title: Time to review the strategy?
